text: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended.
The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.
The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.
Allah does not look at your figures, nor at your attire but He looks at your hearts and accomplishments.
None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself.
Do not disdain a good deed, (no matter how small it may seem) even if it is your meeting with your (Muslim) brother with a cheerful face.
There are two blessings which many people lose: (They are) Health and free time for doing good.
Wealth is not in having many possessions, but rather (true) wealth is feeling sufficiency in the soul.
The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those that are most consistent, even if it is small.

A man said to the Prophet, 'Advise me!' The Prophet said, 'Do not become angry and furious.' The man asked (the same) again and again, and the Prophet said in each case, 'Do not become angry and furious.'
